title: Vietnamese Roasted Noodle Dish
description: A flavorful and nutritious Vietnamese-inspired roasted noodle dish, made with light and easy ingredients.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked noodles to the bowl and toss to coat.
Heat the coconut oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the scallions and cook for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Add the peanuts and cook for an additional minute.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of noodles on a plate and top with the peanut and scallion mixture.
